descriptions.inProgress: Nella said I look much stronger than last time. First request is to get ingredients for Dr. Faymus, the owner of potion shop. He needs #b100 Horny Mushroom Caps#k and #b50 Jr. Necki Skins#k. Taking on Jr. Necki's might be little tough, but I will give it a try.
descriptions.completed: I gave what Dr. Faymus asked for and I got bunch of white potions for return. I wonder what kind of potion would Dr. Faymus make by using those materials. I should get back to Nella for more request.
